semiconductor_relevance: High — SEMPA Systems GmbH specializes in high-purity gas and chemical supply systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: SEMPA Systems GmbH provides high-purity gas and chemical supply systems tailored for the semiconductor and LED industries, as well as for photovoltaic and pharmaceutical applications. With a strong focus on specialized applications, the company leverages its expertise to support critical manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Chemical supply systems for semiconductor applications
Integration of gas and chemical systems into manufacturing processes

regional_presence.Germany: SEMPA Systems GmbH is headquartered in Dresden, Germany, where it employs around 200 people.
